offer.text: My spouse is gone, and the grave looks so bare. Would you gather three poppies, so I might lay them to rest properly?

accept.text: Thank you. They always loved the red ones.

decline.text: I understand. Grief is a heavy thing to share.

in_progress.text: Have you found the poppies? Three is all I ask.

ready.text: Three poppies. They would have smiled to see them.

complete.text: The grave looks loved now. Thank you — truly.
